title: Timed comments that cross the video
blurb: Comments are cues in a metadata text track. Each active one is a drawable element that the canvas draws at a position worked out from the media time of the frame, so it crosses the picture in step with the video. Tap one to stop it and open its Like button. The text can invert the frame or ride a wave.
question: Can comments cross a video as real elements that take taps where they are drawn, placed for the exact frame in the picture?
result: Yes. In every paint of a playing fixture the comment's position was the one for the frame number read from the same picture, and a frame-by-frame export moves each comment by the same step in every frame.
